_readme: TO SEND JESSE A FILE: drop it in this folder and push. That is the whole
process -- the rail lists whatever is in here, so a file with no entry
below still shows up, just under its own filename with no description.
Add an entry here only when the filename alone is not enough. Order in
this file is the order in the rail; anything unlisted sorts after, newest
Nothing in this folder is reachable over the web. netlify.toml 404s the
path, and the only way in is /api/jesse/file, which checks the session
cookie first. That is deliberate: it is the same door as the messages.
The keys under "files" are exact filenames. "password" is shown in the
rail in plain text -- it is a convenience for a zip, not a secret.

ram-report.zip.label: RAM report script
ram-report.zip.note: Extract it, run ram-report.bat, paste what it prints into the thread.

ram-report.bat.label: RAM report script (loose .bat)
ram-report.bat.note: Same thing, not zipped, in case the zip is a hassle. Windows may warn you — that is just because it came from the internet.
